description: This file defines a Language class in the Opencart e-commerce platform, specifically in the Catalog Controller Event namespace. The class manages language variables during different stages of controller execution: by dumping all language variables into template arguments, backing up language data before controller execution, and restoring language data after controller execution.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for managing language data during event triggers in the Opencart system.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Adds all language variables to the template arguments if they are not already set.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Backs up current language variables into a JSON-encoded string stored with the key 'backup'.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language variables from the backup stored previously, reapplying them to the language object.
